content: पत्तिः [पद्-तिन्] .²1 A footman, a foot-soldier; पत्तिः पदातिम् (अभ्यपतत्) <ls>R. 7. 37</ls>; <ls>Ve. 1. 27</ls>. .²2 A pedestrian. .²3 A hero. --{%f.%} .²1 The smallest division of an army, consisting of one chariot, one elephant, three horsemen and five foot-soldiers; एको रथो गजश्चैको नराः पञ्च पदातयः . त्रयश्च तुरगास्तज्ज्ञैः पत्तिरित्यभिधीयते .. <ls>Mb. 1. 2. 19</ls>. .²2 Going, walking.
